title: What Entropy-Based View Selection Cannot See: An Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models such as CLIP can classify images into categories they were never explicitly trained to recognize, but accuracy degrades when test images differ in style or source from their training data. A common remedy generates randomly cropped and flipped copies of each test image, called views, and combines their predictions. Since some views miss the object, methods must identify which views to trust. The dominant approach uses prediction entropy to measure confidence and retains the most certain views. Other methods use signals such as embedding typicality. Despite repeated refinements of these scoring functions, the information they rely on, the model's own response to each view, remains largely unexamined. We investigate this choice while holding other pipeline stages fixed. First, we show that view selection, rather than the gradient update, accounts for almost all accuracy gains. translated_title: 基于熵的视图选择所看不到的：对视觉-语言模型测试时自适应的审计
translated_abstract: 诸如CLIP之类的视觉-语言模型能够将图像分类到它们从未被明确训练去识别的类别中，但当测试图像在风格或来源上与其训练数据存在差异时，准确率会下降。一种常见的补救方法是为每张测试图像生成随机裁剪和翻转的副本（称为视图），并组合它们的预测结果。由于部分视图可能会错过目标物体，这些方法必须识别哪些视图是可信的。主流做法使用预测熵来衡量置信度，并保留最确定的视图；其他方法则使用诸如嵌入典型性等信号。尽管这些评分函数被反复改进，但它们所依赖的信息——即模型自身对每个视图的响应——在很大程度上仍未被审视。我们在保持流程中其他阶段不变的前提下研究了这一选择。首先，我们表明视图选择（而非梯度更新）几乎贡献了全部的准确率提升。随后，我们检验熵是否……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文审计了视觉-语言模型测试时自适应中的熵基视图选择方法，发现视图选择而非梯度更新几乎贡献了全部准确率提升，而现有评分函数所依赖的信息——模型自身对每个视图的响应——在很大程度上仍未被审视。
en_tdlr: This paper audits entropy-based view selection in test-time adaptation for vision-language models, showing that view selection rather than gradient updates accounts for nearly all accuracy gains, while the information underlying existing scoring functions—the model's own response to each view—remains largely unexamined.
